output.explanation: The webhook handler marked an order "paid" on both PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED and PAYMENT.CAPTURE.PENDING. A pending capture means no funds have been credited yet and it can still be denied. The handler now sets "paid" only on COMPLETED and records PENDING as "pending", the same way the capture route already does. A late PENDING event will not downgrade an order that is already paid or refunded, so goods are no longer released for money that never arrives.
output.notes: Nothing to set up for this patch. The webhook still accepts events without signature verification; that is the separate webhook-unverified finding and is still open. If you want orders to leave the "pending" state when PayPal denies a pending capture, also subscribe to PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED. This patch leaves such orders as "pending", which is unpaid.
